capabilities: Add an 'Edit in mermaid.live' link under rendered Mermaid diagrams in Live Preview and Reading view
Open the diagram code preloaded in the Mermaid Live Editor, matching the vault theme
Scale diagrams to fit the note width instead of scrolling
Prevent diagrams from splitting across PDF pages or being stranded below headings
Hide the mermaid.live link in print and PDF output
disambiguation: Not a Mermaid editor or renderer itself; it only links out to mermaid.live and adjusts diagram sizing and printing.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README also covers installation via BRAT and states the plugin makes no network requests (diagram code is base64-encoded into the link URL).
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid diagrams but offers no way to edit them in the Mermaid Live Editor, and wide or long diagrams scroll, split across PDF pages, or get stranded under headings.
summary: Adds an 'Edit in mermaid.live' link beneath every Mermaid diagram and styles diagrams for width control and clean PDF export.
